overview: Nebulae introduces the NLG0192 RS485 Modbus Gateway — a compact, industrial-grade IoT device built to connect legacy Modbus systems to modern cloud platforms. Supporting RS485 Modbus RTU, it communicates with multiple Modbus slave devices at the same time.

It offers secure wireless connectivity, effortless FOTA upgrades and LTE performance, with remote device management, scalable integration and robust data handling for industrial automation, energy monitoring and smart infrastructure.
The gateway allows customers to configure their own MQTT client for flexible and secure cloud communication, and can be configured from a host, web page or serial interface.

why.d: Connect existing RS485 Modbus RTU devices to the cloud without replacing them.
Simultaneous communication with multiple Modbus slave devices.
Configurable MQTT client for AWS, Azure IoT, ThingsBoard or custom brokers.
Remote device management and FOTA firmware upgrades over 4G.
Configure from a host, web page or serial interface.
